verdict.rationale: Tailscale's tailnet model inherently syncs the list of devices ('hosts') across all machines via the central coordination/admin console, and docs show cross-device access (phone, iPad, PC) to the same network and account switching, which implies some settings persistence across devices. However, there is no explicit evidence of a 'saved connection settings' feature (e.g., per-host preferences, favorites, or exit-node choices) syncing beyond the basic device list and ACL policy file. Missing for 10: explicit saved-host/bookmark sync feature, per-device connection preference sync, and independent confirmation that user-level settings (not just admin policy) sync across devices.
